checks.name: malformed and invalid saved data block mutation without overwriting raw
denied initial getItem requires explicit successful reload before mutation
provider property denial is caught inside the store and can recover
failed setItem preserves memory and raw with ordinary retry enabled
new candidate is persisted before in-memory commit
provider denial during write does not revoke confirmed-read readiness
returned state clones cannot mutate stored in-memory records
invalid active configuration writes nothing and valid pause/resume/reset each write once
failed reload becomes unknown and restored record is not silently replaced

limits: Provider/getItem/schema/raw/write/clone integrity only;browser draft preservation and visual/reference quality require separate actual tests.
